tasks.label: Build & Run
tasks.detail: Compile Source/ to GravityGolf.pdx and (re)launch the Simulator
tasks.command: SDK="${PLAYDATE_SDK_PATH:-$HOME/Developer/PlaydateSDK}"; "$SDK/bin/pdc" Source GravityGolf.pdx && { pkill -x 'Playdate Simulator' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.4; open -a "$SDK/bin/Playdate Simulator.app" "$PWD/GravityGolf.pdx"; }

tasks.label: Build only
tasks.detail: Compile Source/ to GravityGolf.pdx without touching the Simulator
